subject: design/argus-draft-attribution
statement: `ResolveFirstPR` admits the configured drafts root plus `/<slug>/`, and the fixed `memory/prd/<slug>/` and `memory/design/<slug>/` subtrees, in addition to its existing slug-derived documents and fixed named allowlist. A different slug, a code path, an authority contract, or a governance document remains outside the drive's permitted scope. The scope never consults a same-PR ledger entry or author-provided path list. The versioned boundary policy changes when this grammar changes.
